title: 第13章 死者交谈第14章 我一定会杀了那个狗杂碎
slug: 艾泽拉斯从掷骰子开始成神
lines: “好了，接下来，我们直接问问他凶手是谁就行了。”
艾伦施法完毕，抬手抹了抹额头上沁出的细汗。
话音刚落，一道凌厉的破风声撕裂夜色，肖尔竟然当场暴起，身形如鬼魅般掠过数步距离，想要制服艾伦，
“说——”他的声音带着刺骨的寒意，“你是什么人？”
温雷虽然怀疑艾伦，但身体下意识地动了起来，他横跨一步，硬生生挡在艾伦身前，抬手格住肖尔刺来的匕首。
铛！
金属交击，溅起几点火星，两人在坟包间快速交换了几招。
护住了艾伦之后，温雷才暗骂自己是不是白痴。
假装艾伦的亲随装傻装到现在，连脑子都装傻了吗？
这家伙都用出死灵魔法了，你还护着他？
斯黛拉也不甘示弱，虽然虽然小脸煞白，却还是从怀里掏出一个圆滚滚的工程学手雷，小手攥着拉环，随时准备扯开引信。
“肖尔，住手！”
瓦里安的声音骤然响起，带着不容置疑的威严。
肖尔的身形一顿，攻势戛然而止，他后退半步，匕首却仍握在手中，警惕地盯着艾伦。
周围的黑暗中，几道潜伏的身影也按捺住了动作，那是军情七处的特工，利箭早已上弦，只待一声令下。
乱葬岗重新陷入寂静，只有夜风吹过荒草发出的沙沙声。
瓦里安上前几步，月光照在他年轻的脸上。
“普瑞斯托先生。”他的声音很平静，却带着压力，“为什么你会使用死灵魔法？”
艾伦深吸一口气。
这个问题，他早就想好了答案。
“您也知道，奥特兰克的疯王艾登·匹瑞诺德曾经与部落进行过合作。”
艾伦迎上瓦里安的视线，语速平缓，神情坦然，“那些绿皮的怪物跟他分享了一些……稀奇古怪的法术，我的家族虽然不认同疯王的做法，但那些法术的记录却散落在外，我因为一些机缘巧合，恰巧获悉了其中一部分。”
他顿了顿，摊开双手，做出一个坦诚的姿态：“但我只学习了一点不太邪恶的魔法。比如这个，它叫‘死者交谈’。”
他指向那具仍坐着的尸体。
“我只是唤醒一位死者，与他进行短暂的交谈而已。做不了别的事情。我们能向他问五个问题，问完之后他就会恢复长眠。如果您实在不相信我……”
然后他再次看向瓦里安，目光真诚：“这些问题由您来问便是。”
艾伦等待着。
等待着系统的游说检定提示音。
然而什么都没有发生。
瓦里安只是盯着他看了几秒，然后，出乎所有人意料地点了点头。
“我相信你。”
他转向肖尔，语气不容置疑：“放下你的武器。肖尔，你来问他，凶手是谁。”
艾伦愣了一下。

"Okay, next, let's just ask him who the murderer is."
After Allen finished casting the spell, he raised his hand to wipe the fine sweat on his forehead.
As soon as he finished speaking, a sharp sound of wind ripped through the night. Xiao suddenly burst into flames on the spot, and passed a few steps away like a ghost, trying to subdue Allen.
"Say-" His voice was filled with a biting chill, "Who are you?"
Although Wen Lei doubted Allen, his body moved subconsciously. He took a step across, blocked Allen, and raised his hand to block the dagger stabbed by Shaw.
clang!
Metal collided, sparks flew up, and the two quickly exchanged a few moves between the tombs.
After protecting Allen, Wen Lei secretly cursed himself for being an idiot.
You've been pretending to be Eren's personal entourage and pretending to be stupid until now. Have you even lost your brain?
This guy has used necromancy magic, and you're still protecting him?
Stella was not to be outdone. Although her face was pale, she still took out a round engineering grenade from her arms, holding the pull ring in her small hand, ready to pull the fuse at any time.
"Shore, stop!"
Varian's voice suddenly sounded, with unquestionable majesty.
Shaw paused, and the attack came to an abrupt end. He took half a step back, but still held the dagger in his hand, staring at Allen warily.
In the surrounding darkness, several lurking figures also restrained their movements. They were agents from MI7. Their sharp arrows had already been slung, just waiting for an order.
The mass grave fell into silence again, with only the rustling of the grass in the night wind.
Varian took a few steps forward, the moonlight shining on his young face.
"Mr. Presto." His voice was calm but full of pressure, "Why do you use necromancy?"
Allen took a deep breath.
He had already thought of the answer to this question.
"You also know that the Mad King of Alterac, Aiden Perenold, once cooperated with the Horde."
Allen met Varian's gaze, speaking slowly and with a calm expression, "Those green-skinned monsters shared some... strange spells with him. Although my family does not agree with the Mad King's approach, the records of those spells are scattered around. Due to some chance, I happened to learn about some of them."
He paused, spread his hands, and made a frank gesture: "But I have only learned a little bit of magic that is not too evil. For example, this one is called 'Conversation with the Dead'."
He pointed to the still seated body.
"I just woke up a dead man and had a brief conversation with him. I can't do anything else. We can ask him five questions, and after asking him, he will return to sleep. If you really don't believe me..."
Then he looked at Varian again with a sincere look: "It's up to you to ask these questions."
Alan waited.
Waiting for the system's lobbying test prompt.
But nothing happened.
Varian just stared at him for a few seconds, then, to everyone's surprise, nodded.
"I believe you."
He turned to Shaw, his tone unquestionable: "Put down your weapons. Shaw, ask him who the murderer is."
Allen was stunned for a moment.
